jane_support: Heads up — AcmeCorp (large customer) is getting repeated failures from function/tool calling when using JSON mode. Started ~2026-03-15T10:12Z. They get a parsing/validation error and billing is affected. Posting minimal repro + runtime snippets below.

jane_support: curl repro (redacted API key)
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"gpt-4o-redwood",
    "input":"charge user",
    "json_mode": true,
    "functions":[{"name":"charge_customer","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"user_id":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"}},"required":["user_id","amount"]}}],
    "function_call": {"name":"charge_customer"},
    "function_args": {"amount": 49.99}
  }'
```

jane_support: API response:
```
{"error":"InvalidToolArgsError","message":"missing required key 'user_id' in function_args for 'charge_customer'","code":"INVALID_TOOL_ARGS"}
```

jane_support: runtime snippet:
```
[runtime] 2026-03-15T10:12:34Z ERROR handler.go:234 invalid tool args: missing key user_id for tool charge_customer, req=req_0a1b2c3d
```

jane_support: Customer says this used to work and started after last night's model rollout. Severity P1 — billing flow blocked. Can someone triage? @alex_eng_ml

alex_eng_ml: ACK. I'll try to repro locally with their body and req id req_0a1b2c3d. Do you have full proxy logs or the exact payload the customer sent?

jane_support: attaching proxy snippet — looks like the proxy sanitized nulls and stripped empty fields: 
```
[p-proxy] 2026-03-15T10:12:33Z DEBUG sanitize.go:78 dropping keys with null: {"user_id":null}
[p-proxy] 2026-03-15T10:12:33Z DEBUG request.go:102 outbound body: {"function_args":{"amount":49.99}}
```

deploy-bot: finished rollout gpt-4o-redwood@v2026-03-14-23 to hosted cluster eu-west-1 (rollout id r-2026-03-14-23) :rocket:

alex_eng_ml: hmm — two hypotheses: 1) model runtime now enforces function parameter 'required' strictly in JSON mode (previously lenient), or 2) our proxy sanitizer started dropping keys with explicit null which then causes required->missing. Reproducing now.

alex_eng_ml: quick question — is the SDK or frontend using a patch that converts empty strings to null? If proxy drops nulls that's likely the gap. If we can't change the proxy quickly, we should offer customer a short-term workaround to send an explicit user_id string (e.g., "unknown") or include a placeholder id.

maria_support_manager: escalate to eng-oncall and product. If rollback required, we need manager signoff. @tom_sre can you standby for rollback verification?

tom_sre: oncall pinged and looking at logs. If rollback needed we can revert rollout r-2026-03-14-23 within 20m. Also adding a temporary edge rule to avoid dropping explicit empty-string keys for /v1/generate from AcmeCorp IPs.

alex_eng_ml: repro steps done locally: when proxy strips nulls the runtime returns InvalidToolArgsError exactly as reported. With an explicit placeholder user_id the function call succeeds. Creating internal issue INF-1329 with traces and adding request id req_0a1b2c3d.

jane_support: thanks. I've told AcmeCorp the workaround (send placeholder user_id) and that eng is investigating. Marking P1. I will update customer after we have a fix or rollback plan. :thumbsup:

maria_support_manager: keeping this open — tom, please confirm rollback window/status in channel. alex, attach quick patch diff or mitigation plan to INF-1329. Support will follow up on SLA timeline.
